description:
Find hotels and motels in California and Nevada that will take a specific dog, with the estimated pet fee for the stay.

Every amount is the hotel's pet fee, never the room rate: DogPolicies has no room prices.

Each hotel is sorted into "match" (the policy says yes on everything asked), "possible" (nothing rules it out, but something needs a call: a hotel that decides case by case, an unstated weight limit, a limit the hotel lifts with its approval, an "up to" fee) or excluded (left out). Matches come first, cheapest pet fee first. The fee arithmetic is spelled out for every result.

Examples:
  - "Will a Monterey hotel take my 70 lb Lab for under $50?" -> county="Monterey", dog_weight_lb=70, max_total_fee=50
  - "Two dogs, three nights near Palm Springs" -> near={lat:33.83, lon:-116.55}, dogs=2, nights=3
  - "Is the Motel 6 in Fresno dog friendly?" -> query="Motel 6 Fresno"
  - "A Las Vegas hotel for my 60 lb dog" -> county="Clark", state="NV", dog_weight_lb=60

area.description: Area id, the name a traveler gives the trip: san-francisco, east-bay, peninsula, south-bay, north-bay, lake-tahoe, big-sur, mendocino-coast, yosemite, death-valley

county.description: County name without "County", in California or Nevada, e.g. "Monterey" or "Washoe"

include_possible.description: Include hotels that need a call to confirm

max_total_fee.description: Most the guest will pay in pet fees for the whole stay, USD

near.description: Limit to places near a point; results are sorted by distance

query.description: Words in the hotel name, city or brand

region.description: Region id, e.g. central-coast, san-diego or reno-tahoe-nevada

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text, 'json' for structured data

state.description: "CA" or "NV". Also tells apart counties with the same name, such as Humboldt.

name: dogpolicies_find_hotels

citation.description: Copy-ready citation: answer, source, date checked, record URL, license

confidence.description: stated: the place's own source says it; inferred_from_agency: an agency-wide rule; inherited_brand: the chain's policy, not confirmed by this hotel

freshness.description: fresh: inside its review interval; due: past it; stale: past twice it, confirm before you go; unreadable: the last check could not read the source

uid.description: Stable id that survives a rename

title: Find hotels for a dog
